meta.title: DeepSeek Balance
meta.description: Shows the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar: a status ring at a glance, the exact amounts in its popover.

en.popover.title: Account balance
en.settings.hint.clientPollSeconds: How often the display refreshes; cache-only while healthy.
en.settings.hint.displayCurrency: Falls back to a currency the account actually holds.
en.settings.hint.manualRefreshCooldownSecon: Minimum gap between two manual refreshes.
en.settings.hint.refreshAdvanced: Rarely changed: the defaults suit most setups.
en.settings.hint.serverRefreshSeconds: How often the official API is called.
en.settings.hint.threshold: Decided on the server; the UI colour follows the returned severity.
en.settings.hint.thresholdPair: Critical must be lower than warning
en.settings.invalidNumber: Enter a number; leave empty to use the default.
en.settings.sources.accountNoService: This deployment ships no account service, so this source is unavailable.
en.settings.sources.groupNote: Both sources follow the official setup: the key comes from the official Models page, the account is the one signed in to the host. This plugin stores no credential of its own.
en.settings.sources.sourceSaved: From the credential saved on the Models page
en.settings.sources.title: Balance sources
en.sidebar.aria.mismatch: Shown currency differs from your selection
en.sidebar.label: DeepSeek balance
